note: Independent CURRENT-Core source rejudgment against RFC1334 Section2.2.2 (stable requirement ID retains2.3): acceptable Peer-ID/password requires a PAP Authenticate-Ack Code2. Complete TestPAPRequestEmitsEvent sends actual PAP credentials over a pipe, inspects the genuine auth request, answers its private capability with acceptance, and requires ProtoPAP, Authenticate-Ack, echoed Identifier0x42, success event and successful handler return. Distinct TestPAPRejectWritesNak sends different valid credentials and an explicit rejection, requiring ProtoPAP and Nak, so unconditional Ack is refused. runPAPAuthPhase uses the actual decision only at the Ack/Nak writer choice; WritePAPAck encodes the declared Code2. No trailing malformed data or earlier unrelated error masks the branch. Scope is protocol response to provider decision; local credential verification is a separate boundary. Fresh discriminator execution is owed.
